forcedPrediction.limitations: Independent legal late-street positions; predicts old bots, not human validation. Lower loss and Brier are better.

naturalPrediction.limitations: Natural old-bot actions, no forced late positions. Test-hand actions never update the prior belief. Own strength only used for supervised validation labels, not public style inference. No human evidence.

headsUpAblation.limitations: Ablation: same public range and no lookahead, inferred belief is the only strategy difference. Only public completed actions used to infer styles. Warm-up and test deals independent; teacher-family tests with reset stacks, not human winnings probability. Seat legs grouped; block profit uses averaged seat outcomes.

fourPlayerAblation.limitations: Ablation: same public range and no lookahead, inferred belief is the only strategy difference. Only public completed actions used to infer styles. Warm-up and test deals independent; teacher-family tests with reset stacks, not human winnings probability. Seat legs grouped; block profit uses averaged seat outcomes.

limitations: Increased data and longer history both differ from round3
Baseline is public pooled range without lookahead, not production policy
Synthetic reset-stack blocks are not real continuous profit probabilities
